source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: 中国元首外交的思想启迪
topics.why_hot: This is the top real-time hot topic on Baidu, indicating strong public attention to the ideas and strategy shaping China's top-level diplomacy.
topics.share_angle: Help English-speaking viewers understand how Chinese media frame head-of-state diplomacy, and what themes they use to present foreign policy as a source of inspiration.

topics.chinese_topic: “学成了 希望你们能够回来”
topics.official_english: After completing your studies, we hope you can come back
topics.why_hot: This compact, emotional phrase has gone viral after being highlighted online; it speaks to the value Chinese society places on education and on bringing skills back home.
topics.share_angle: Explain why a single sentence about coming back after graduation carries so much weight in today's Chinese internet discourse.

topics.chinese_topic: 郑钦文2比0斯瓦泰克晋级八强
topics.official_english: Zheng Qinwen beats Swiatek 2-0 to reach the quarterfinals
topics.why_hot: Zheng Qinwen is one of China's most prominent athletes, and a straight-sets result against a well-known international rival is creating a new burst of sports buzz.
topics.share_angle: Provide a compact match result plus broader context on why Chinese sports fans follow Zheng Qinwen so closely.

topics.chinese_topic: 雷军发布小米迄今最贵手机
topics.official_english: Lei Jun unveils Xiaomi's most expensive phone to date
topics.why_hot: Xiaomi's chief executive carries huge personal influence online, so a new flagship with an eye-catching price point becomes an instant hot topic.
topics.share_angle: Discuss what this pricing step says about Xiaomi's brand ambitions and China's intensifying high-end smartphone competition.

topics.chinese_topic: 废品回收被中国人做成万亿级产业
topics.official_english: How scrap recycling became a trillion-yuan industry in China
topics.why_hot: It reframes an often-overlooked everyday sector as a huge engine of value, surprising many users on social media.
topics.share_angle: Use the topic as a way to explain China's recycling ecosystem and the economic logic behind waste collection and reprocessing.

topics.chinese_topic: 智能眼镜卖疯了 退货率却高达70%
topics.official_english: Smart glasses sell quickly, but return rate hits 70 percent
topics.why_hot: The contrast between strong sales and an extremely high return rate raises questions about hype versus real-world usefulness.
topics.share_angle: Explore the sales-versus-returns gap and what it signals for the smart glasses market.

topics.chinese_topic: 柏林一座少女雕像为何让日本气急败坏
topics.official_english: Why a Berlin statue of a young girl enrages Japan
topics.why_hot: A statue in Berlin provoking strong Japanese reactions creates an international story that Chinese social-media users are discussing intensely.
topics.share_angle: Explain the symbolism of public monuments and why a single statue can create diplomatic friction between countries.

topics.chinese_topic: 江西遂川万安这些涉灾信息不实
topics.official_english: Disaster-related claims about Suichuan and Wan'an, Jiangxi, are false
topics.why_hot: When disaster-related anxiety is high, prompt fact-checking of unverified local claims becomes a focus of public discussion.
topics.share_angle: Highlight how official refutation notices work in China and why verifying disaster information is important for public safety.
